answer: A hostile operator running 168 aliases therefore needs 105 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in garden, expire in trellis, and dawn lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3560 identities would post 2401 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
